outcome: No progress, claim, or resolution found since 26 January 2024; the known computational bound (no odd weird number below 10^21, and none with abundance below 10^14 below 10^28, per Fang, arXiv:2207.12906, submitted 26 July 2022) remains the current state of the art, and the problem is unchanged.
summary: This is an existence question ('do any odd weird numbers exist?'), which under §3.1 is only advanced by an actual answer, not by extending a computational search. I searched broadly for any post-26-January-2024 developments — direct searches for the phrase 'odd weird number' combined with 2024/2025/2026, searches for updates or citations to Fang's 2022 paper (arXiv:2207.12906, the paper establishing the current best-known bounds: no odd weird number below 10^21, and none with abundance below 10^14 below 10^28), and a check of the OEIS sequence page (A006037) that tracks the history of this search. The OEIS comment history shows a clear progression of bounds from 2005 (10^17) through 2013, 2014, and a final 2015 entry (10^28 for low-abundance candidates) and Fang's 2022 arXiv writeup of that same search — but nothing dated 2024, 2025, or 2026. The Wikipedia 'Weird number' article's current text ('It is not known if any odd weird numbers exist. If so, they must be greater than 10^21') is unchanged from the pre-snapshot state and cites the same OEIS source. No new preprint, announcement, or computational search extending this bound was found anywhere. I therefore agree with the triage's 'none' verdict: nothing has happened to this problem in the window, and no AI system has been involved. This is a well-evidenced 'nothing happened' result per §5, not an under-researched one.
competing_reading: None. The bound is a record-extension type quantity (largest verified search radius), but per §3.1 an existence/infinitude question ('do any exist') is not advanced by a larger search radius alone — it would need to be the type of bullet asking for the value of a constant or a largest known object, which this is not. There is no genuine ambiguity here about scope.
what_would_settle_it: A proof that no odd weird number exists, an explicit odd weird number exhibited and verified, or (short of resolution) a new preprint extending Fang's 10^21 / 10^28 computational bounds — none of which were found.
